name: Sourcebound RAG fixture benchmark
metric_disclosure: Fixture-mode metrics are deterministic proxy metrics over the curated offline corpus; they are not live-web quality measurements or a substitute for human review.

cases.name: rag-benefits
cases.question: What are the benefits of retrieval-augmented generation?

criteria.description: At least three quarters of expected benefit concepts appear in retrieved evidence.
The synthesized answer covers at least three quarters of expected benefit concepts.
Most generated findings have lexical overlap with their cited evidence.

cases.name: rag-production-tradeoffs
cases.question: What are the production trade-offs of retrieval-augmented generation?

criteria.description: Production retrieval risks should be present in the evidence set.
The answer should mention the main operational trade-offs.
Most generated trade-off findings should overlap their cited evidence.

cases.name: rag-grounding
cases.question: How does retrieval-augmented generation ground model answers?

criteria.description: The evidence set should contain concepts describing retrieval-based grounding.
The answer should explain how external evidence grounds generation.
Generated grounding findings should overlap their cited evidence.
